verdict.rationale: Meltano documents building your own connector with its SDK for Singer Connectors, so a custom tap is built on a supported framework rather than forked. A community user confirms developing a custom tap with the SDK and calls the experience top class. missing for 10: in-depth first-party SDK documentation (auth, pagination, schema handling for REST APIs), any low-code/no-code builder option.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I build a custom connector for a long-tail API with a supported framework or low-code builder, not a fork

citations.quote: Build your own Meltano connector to move data from any source to any destination.
The SDK for Singer Connectors & EDK for Meltano Components are easy to use.
Build, adjust, and debug connectors directly.
When I had to develop a custom tap for a client, the support I received from the team, the SDK and the general experience was absolutely top class.
